row_semantics: One printed table-cell source entry; a cell can identify a group or institution
name_amount_split: Only source-provided parts or literal currency suffix; no Arabic-number/currency normalization
empty_amount_source: No amount parsed in the main cell, not zero; associated note strings retained
notes: All associated source notes remain in their original order; annual-looking lines are not reconciled or converted into computed totals
printed_totals: Original printed-total unit remains in book.json/TXT/TEI; not computed by this dataset
